parsed.rationale: Both `CacheLoader` (package `Caching`) and `MetadataLoader` (package `Metadata`) share three identical members — `cacheKey:String`, `invalidate:() async`, and `lastLoadedAt:Date?` — and differ only in the return type of `load`: `Data` vs `PlaycutMetadata`. This is the canonical PAT pattern: a single protocol with an `associatedtype Payload` and a `load:() async throws -> Payload` requirement would unify both interfaces without loss of type safety. `CacheLoader` would conform with `Payload == Data` and `MetadataLoader` with `Payload == PlaycutMetadata`. The new protocol should live in the `Caching` package (or a shared `Core`/`Shared` package if one exists) so both packages can depend on it.
